"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Donald Trump prioritizes himself and his wealthy friends.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump's allies predicted his tax cut would push economic growth as high as 6 percent.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"America's growth rate barely changed after the 2017 tax cut.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 2017 tax cut had no impact on the average American's income.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 2017 tax cut boosted wages only for those in the top 10 percent.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's allies claimed the 2017 tax cut would pay for itself.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 2017 tax cut exploded the federal deficit by $2 trillion.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's policies added more to the national debt than has been added in any previous presidential term.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
